method: read by Claude (vision): 3x3 sweep of 448 px crops at 2x; every candidate confirmed at 6x (+-40 px); 24·5, 17·5, B.M.14·65 and B.M.18·48 re-zoomed at 8x (+-30 px) and 24·5 searched at 4x (+-60 px); positions in mosaic pixels
legibility: very good; sparse open ground, clean digits at 6x; no sheet join detected or seen; grey margin strips of a few px at the west and east edges
